Content

Genes with significant interactions based on Stouffer method, including effect sizes, p-values and recurrence across conditions.
MAGeCK results for antibiotic vs untreated comparisons, covering only genes identified by either method.
Agreement between methods and recurrence of each gene’s interactions across conditions.
Candidate sensitizing or protective interactions supported by mismatch-guide profiles.
Recurrent sensitizing and protective genes grouped by transcriptional unit (TU).
TU-level effects and interaction calls calculated from pooled guides.
KEGG pathway enrichment results for recurrent sensitizing and protective hits, analysed at gene and TU levels.
Comparison of recurrent hits with published aminoglycoside-response data from Murray et al. (2015).

Raw p < {{p_stouffer}} and median guide log₂FC ≤ min(−{{lfc_floor}}, comparison median − {{mad_multiplier}} unscaled MAD) for sensitizing calls, or ≥ max(+{{lfc_floor}}, median + {{mad_multiplier}} MAD) for protective calls. Per-comparison cutoffs are in counts_thresholds.
Same-direction calls in ≥{{recurrence_min}} of the {{n_T1}} T1 contrasts: {{recurrence_conditions}}. TOB 0.4 T2 is excluded from recurrence.
Directional MAGeCK RRA FDR < {{mageck_fdr}}, without an LFC cutoff. Both directions significant is Ambiguous. These analyses use the same screen counts.
{{n_sensitizing}} sensitizing and {{n_protective}} protective genes, defined by Stouffer recurrence. MAGeCK comparison does not redefine these primary sets.

Recurrent gene hits collapse to {{n_TU_sensitizing}} sensitizing and {{n_TU_protective}} protective TUs. Separate pooled-guide TU testing combines eligible full-match guides by TU and applies the raw-p/adaptive-MAD rule to TU effects.

Gene query sizes: {{gene_query_sensitizing}} sensitizing and {{gene_query_protective}} protective genes. TU query sizes: {{TU_query_sensitizing}} and {{TU_query_protective}}. Background: {{gene_universe}} evaluable genes mapped to {{TU_universe}} TUs.
One-sided Fisher overrepresentation test (alternative = greater), with BH adjustment separately for each direction and gene/TU level across {{n_KEGG_terms}} terms retained at both levels.
A TU inherits terms from its member genes and is counted once per term. Queries are TUs containing recurrent gene-level hits. This differs from pooled-guide TU testing.
Coverage = 100 × overlap / term-background size. Fold enrichment = overlap / (query size × term-background size / universe size). The odds ratio is the Fisher-test estimate.

Exploratory candidates required ≥{{min_guides}} guides, ≥{{min_bins}} bins with ≥{{min_bin_guides}} guides each, and a threshold crossing by predicted relative efficacy {{partial_max}}. LOESS fits used ≥{{loess_min_bins}} qualified bins and required excursion AUC ≥{{loess_auc}} and total excursion width ≥{{loess_width}} over efficacy {{loess_min_x}}–{{loess_max_x}}. Conventional same-direction calls and genes recurrent in either direction were excluded. Candidate interactions require individual validation.

GEN = gentamicin; NEO = neomycin; TOB = tobramycin. Murray calls require FDR < {{murray_fdr}} and |logFC| ≥{{murray_lfc}}. Concordant support is the same direction in ≥1 Murray condition; min2 requires ≥2.

BH adjustment was applied within each complete gene-level comparison, before selecting hits. Requiring adjusted p < {{bh_cut}} in addition to the original rules retained {{BH_sensitizing}}/{{n_sensitizing}} sensitizing and {{BH_protective}}/{{n_protective}} protective recurrent genes.
